# mirrorNewWebsite 每新出现一个网站，这个网站的第一个请求，将会在这里被调用！
mirrorNewWebsite = func(isHttps /*bool*/, url /*string*/, req /*[]byte*/, rsp /*[]byte*/, body /*[]byte*/) {
	host, port, err := str.ParseStringToHostPort(url)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}

	urls = str.ParseStringToUrlsWith3W(str.HostPort(host, port))
	for _, url := range urls {
		faviconUrl = str.f("%v%v", str.ParseStringUrlToWebsiteRootPath(url), "favicon.ico")
		// yakit_output(faviconUrl)
		hash, err = http.RequestFaviconHash(faviconUrl)
		if err != nil {
			// yakit_output(sprintf("fetch favicon.ico failed: %v", err))
			continue
		}
		// yakit_output("ICON HASH: " + hash)

		for _, r := range faviconRules {
			keywords = make([]string)
			for _, k := range r.keyword {
				keywords = append(keywords, k)
			}
			
			if str.StringSliceContains(keywords, hash) {
				// yakit_output("监测到一个新ICON: " + sprintf())
				yakit_output(r)
			}
		}
	}
}
